loadingTips.title: Field Tips
items: Press Z before moving, or double-tap the selected tile, to send only half your army and keep more strength behind.
Plains grow only once every 25 seconds, so grabbing a tile right before the income tick lets it start producing immediately.
Swamps keep draining armies after you take them, so do not stack too much there unless you need the route or the block.

onboarding.title: New here? Start with one tutorial match
onboarding.copy: Jump straight into a practice match and learn while playing: start from your capital, expand, then capture enemy capitals.

tutorialAutoStart.title: Entering practice match
tutorialAutoStart.copy: Follow the top guide once the match begins: move out from your capital, expand, then capture enemy capitals.
tutorialAutoStart.waitingHost: Waiting for host to start the tutorial...

idle.greeting: Hi {{player}}, I'm your strategist, and I'll keep you posted on the battlefield.

messages.enemyInTerritory: {{player}} has pushed {{units}} troops into your territory.
messages.enemyNearCapital: {{player}} is only {{distance}} tiles from your capital.
messages.frontlinePressure: {{player}} is pressing the line with {{count}} active border threats.

tutorialGuide.cityHint: Cities and capitals produce 1 unit every turn, so grabbing a city early is usually worth it.
tutorialGuide.captureHint: After one capital falls, keep looking for the next one. You win when every enemy capital is yours.
tutorialGuide.moveHint: You can move with WASD, arrow keys, mouse clicks, or mobile drag. A tile needs at least 2 units to move because 1 unit must stay behind.

first_move.title: Learn the basic move
first_move.copy: Move from your capital into a neighboring tile to learn the basic attack flow.
first_move.copyTouch: Touch the selected tile and drag into a neighboring tile to make your first move.

grow_income.title: Spread out to grow faster
grow_income.copy: Expand first because more land means your army grows faster over time.
grow_income.copyTouch: Drag outward from your land to claim more tiles because more land grows your army faster.

split_army.title: Try a half-army move
split_army.copy: Press Z before moving to split your army and keep more units behind.
split_army.copyTouch: Double-tap the selected tile to send half, then drag one tile to keep more units behind.

hunt_king.title: Capture enemy capitals
hunt_king.copy: Push through your own land and capture one enemy capital next.
hunt_king.copyTouch: Select your front tile, then drag along the front line toward an enemy capital.

howToPlay.title: How to Play
howToPlay.goal: Your goal is to capture every opponent's capital (crown tile).
howToPlay.plains: Plains produce 1 unit every 25 turns. Expanding territory helps you build up faster.
howToPlay.cities: Cities and capitals produce 1 unit every turn
howToPlay.moves: You can move twice per turn.
howToPlay.capture: When you capture an enemy capital, their territory becomes yours instantly (army is halved).
howToPlay.how-to-toggle-50: Z / Click Twice / Mobile: Double-tap the selected tile
howToPlay.wsad: WSAD / ArrowKey / MouseClick / Mobile: Select then drag to a neighboring tile
howToPlay.beginnerTutorial: If this is your first match, open the standalone Tutorial from the lobby and learn capitals, movement, and king captures in 7 steps.
